mapper.insert: insert into outbox( user_id, topic, message_id, payload, delivery_type, target, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{topic}, #{messageId}, #{payload}, #{deliveryType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{target, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{state}, 0, now(), now(), now() )
mapper.select: select id, user_id, topic, message_id, payload, delivery_type, target, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, sent_at from outbox where state = 'pending' and next_retry_at <= now() order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update outbox set state = 'sending', updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId} and message_id = #{messageId} and state = 'pending'
update outbox set state = 'sent', sent_at = now(), updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId} and message_id = #{messageId} and state = 'sending'
update outbox set state = 'pending', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId} and message_id = #{messageId} and state = 'sending'
update outbox set state = 'dead', updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId} and message_id = #{messageId} and state = 'sending'
update outbox set state = 'consumed', consumed_at = now(), updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId} and message_id = #{messageId} and state in ('sent', 'pending')
mapper.select: select count(*) from outbox where state = #{state}
select count(*) from outbox where delivery_type = #{deliveryType} and state = #{state}
